Title: I get an error message saying, "Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time" or "Delayed network connection." What can I do?
Content: There are six possible cases for this issue. Please see them below and adopt appropriate solution. Due to internet disconnection Please connect to the internet and try logging in again. Due to slow internet speed when connecting to CLO authentication server. Please change your authentication type by contacting us. Due to an anti-virus program An anti-virus of a PC may inhibit launching CLO. Please uninstall the anti-virus program and try logging in again. If CLO launches successfully after the uninstall, please contact us. Due to a user PC's firewall setting The firewall setting of a PC may inhibit launching CLO. Please unblock the firewall and try logging in again. If CLO launches successfully after the uninstall, please contact us. Due to a user's company's firewall setting Sometimes, a company may have a firewall setting interfere with CLO. Please check with in-house IT team. Due to a user's proxy server setting Please contact us for the help.

Title: The simulation result is different when using GPU Simulation.
Content: As the collision is calculated with a different algorithm when using GPU for Simulation, it is normal to have different results compared to when using CPU for Simulation. The GPU Simulation feature added to CLO ver5.0.0 is not as stable as the Normal Simulation option when simulating multi-layered garments. In order to moderate the issue, Add'l Thickness - Collision value between garments increases to the same value as their Particle Distance which will return to original value when the Simulation option is reverted to CPU. Additionally, Add'l Thickness - Collision value between garments and avatar will be fixed at 1.5mm. Please make a note of below when using GPU Simulation. To quickly create a single layer garment Check silhouettes quickly with GPU Simulation at the initial stage. Switch to the Normal Simulation option which is supported with CPU to add more layers to the garment. To edit a heavy garment with multiple layers in Simulation Use GPU Simulation after stabilizing the heavy garment with the Normal Simulation option. e.g. to show details inside a jacket Do NOT use GPU Simulation in the Animation Mode As GPU Simulation is not capable of calculating intense collision which occurs during animation due to avatars' movement, please use the Complete Simulation option for stable simulation. Even the Normal Simulation option, the default option for CPU Simulation, is not recommended for the Animation Mode.

Title: I use a 2D CAD system from another software company. Can I still use CLO?
Content: Yes, as long as the 2D CAD patterns are exported in DXF-AAMA or DXF-ASTM format, they can be imported into CLO.

Content: Yes, your device must be connected to the internet when you log in to access CLO. Please note that CLO for Individuals, a subscription-based plan, cannot be used offline.

Title: Can I sell or transfer ownership of my license to another person?
Content: No, you may not sell or transfer ownership of your license to another person.

Content: Under our Terms or Policy, any misused Individual Licenses are technically subject to immediate suspension or termination at the sole discretion of our Legal Department. Here is a friendly reminder: CLO Terms require any business with more than one full-time employee to purchase an Enterprise License. Individual Licenses are reserved for personal hobbyists, freelancers, and one-person companies. The documents must prove that they registered as a one-person company or freelancer. To avoid any unnecessary interruption to your business and CLO software access, please reach out via Contact Us to let us know about your companys structure with proven documentation. Our team will follow up as soon as possible to guide you to further steps.

Title: I get the pop-up about the suspension of Individual plan. What should I do?
Content: If you see this pop-up and watermark on your CLO screen, this means you are potentially in violation of CLO license policy and are belonging to one of the following: a member of an entity that has at least one(1) full-time employee other than you. making purchases of our Services or CLO Software using a corporate credit card. registering for a CLO account using a corporate email account, corporate email address, or corporate domain name. accessing the CLO Software through a computer owned by an Enterprise/Academic entity. Please note that the eligibility of Individual plan is a one-person company, a sole proprietorship, a single-member LLC that does not elect to be treated as a corporation for tax purposes (disregarded entity), a freelancer, a self-employed independent contractor, or similarly situated self-employee otherwise in business for yourself. To remove the suspension for Individual subscription, you need to be verified through independent documentation such as articles of incorporation, business registration, tax returns/filings, proof of Self-Employment Tax payment, etc. Please contact us with your account and corresponsive documentation.

Title: What is the difference between CLO for Individual and CLO for Enterprise?
Content: The licensing policies, features, and services are divided based on user types. Content: No, deleted accounts cannot be recovered. When an account is deleted, your CLO account information is permanently removed, along with your previous subscription and payment history. Therefore, please consider carefully before considering deleting your account.

Title: Does CLO come with a renderer?
Content: Yes. CLO provides a renderer to produce photo-realistic 3D Garments.

Title: Can I simulate flesh and muscles of Avatars?
Content: No. You cannot simulate flesh and muscles of Avatars in CLO.

Title: Can I use CLO's default Motion files for body-scanned Avatars?
Content: To use CLO's default Motion files for body-scanned Avatars, an advanced configuration so called "Rigging" must be performed and the Rigging structure of the body-scanned Avatars and CLO's default Motion files' Rigging structure must be exactly the same.

Title: Can I use my own accessories (hair, shoes, etc.) for CLO Avatars?
Content: You may import personal accessories into CLO as OBJ, FBX and other 3D file types, but they won't be automatically placed where the Avatar's hair or shoes is. To use personal accessories as CLO's hair and shoes, some advanced configuration need to be made in other 3D tools such as Maya. If you would like to use accessories other than default items, please check out CLO-SET CONNECT.

Title: Does CLO come with default Avatars?
Content: Yes, CLO provides six female Avatars, six male Avatars, and four child avatars as default. You can find the default avatars in the avatar folder of CLO software. Moreover, you can also find more free avatars, hair, and poses via CONNECT

Title: Is it possible to have an Avatar that has the exact specs as my fit model?
Content: Yes. You may modify and use the default Avatar if the Avatar's size can be approximately the same as your fit model. Also, you may purchase an Avatar similar to your fit model in CLO-SET CONNECT. However, you need to customize your Avatar through 3D modeling companies if the Avatar's size needs to be exactly the same as your fit model. If you would like to customize your Avatar, please contact the CLO Global Support Team.

Title: Does the Pattern change if I change the size of the Avatar?
Content: No. Even if you change the size of the Avatar, Patterns maintain their size before the modification.

Title: Does CLO offer offline training?
Content: Yes, CLO also offers offline training for Individual users as well as Enterprise and Academic users. If you are an individual user, check our Instagram page where you will find the next offline workshops posted. If you are an Enterprise or Academic user, please contact our business team.

Title: Is it OK to use non-genuine CLO software?
Content: CLO Virtual Fashion Inc. does not approve the supply or use of non-genuine CLO software, and it is not OK. Furthermore, spyware and viruses can be spread using non-genuine CLO software. According to IDC, firms that receive or install unauthorized software or purchase a computer with unlicensed software have a one-in-three probability of encountering malware (29 percent). To protect you against non-genuine CLO software, please purchase from clo3d.com or an authorized reseller to ensure that you are getting authentic CLO software. CLO works hard to keep you safe from fraudulent sellers by ensuring that only genuine CLO software is available for purchase.
